Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Produce ONE production game battle SD sprite of the adult woman AYoon in reference image 1. Reference image 1 is the identity, clothing and accessory source. Reference image 2 is rendering/proportions quality reference ONLY, do NOT copy its white dress or long wavy hair.
Create a polished 2D hand-painted Korean collectible RPG full-body super-deformed adult character, approximately 3.5 heads high with a readable beautiful recognizable adult face. Preserve the source woman's face shape, dark eyes, petite nose, gentle smiling mouth and dark hair tucked under the very distinctive plush blue-and-white cat cap with two blue cat ears and dangling white ear flaps. Preserve her loose WHITE short-sleeved T-shirt, grey athletic shorts visible under the T-shirt, cream/light yellow clogs and delicate necklace. Simplify small shirt graphics into nontext motifs. No new armor or dress.
Single adult female, standing on both feet in a balanced battle-ready stance, body facing slightly toward screen RIGHT at a three-quarter isometric angle, face visible toward viewer, one small open hand raised naturally. Full head, hat, both hands, legs and both shoes entirely visible. No seated or bent-leg photo pose. Do NOT include the giant yellow mascot, plush rabbit, background wall, display props or any second character. Cute stylized proportions without infant or child facial anatomy. Crisp luminous 2D painted hair and cloth, excellent hands and folds, tidy silhouette, elegant readable small-scale details. Consistent existing RPG sprite style, not pixel art, not a plastic 3D toy.
OUTPUT: PNG with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha=0 outside the character). No painted checkerboard, no solid background, no scene, no floor, no drop shadow, no aura or loose effects, no text, logo, watermark or frame. Center the full figure with 8% empty transparent safety margin on every edge. Aim for square canvas 1536x1536, toes near y=0.90, centered horizontal foot pivot. Character opaque, smooth antialiased transparent contour.

Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Produce ONE production game battle SD sprite for the adult male card AIZEN JOKSUKE (Cheolgu dressed as Sosuke Aizen). Reference 1 is the EXACT primary identity and costume source. Reference 2 is ONLY the existing game's rendering/proportions example, do NOT use its generic handsome face or business suit.
Most important: immediately recognizable CHEOLGU face from reference 1, with round cheeks, broad softly rounded jaw, wide round dark eyes, straight thick eyebrows, distinct nose and his slightly amused closed-mouth smile. Keep his face recognizably round and Korean, do not turn into thin-faced anime Aizen or generic handsome actor. Preserve swept-back dark hair and one hanging forehead lock. Translate the exact white high-collared Aizen long coat with BLACK lining, black V-neck robe, black wide sash and white lower garments into polished 2D game SD. Preserve asymmetry of the collar and cloth layers. Full-body new pose with both feet firmly planted in white boots, 3.5-head-high adult SD proportions. Body in three-quarter isometric battle-ready view toward screen RIGHT while face remains clearly visible to viewer. One arm extended in Aizen's calm, commanding open-palm gesture and the other relaxed near his hip. Coat tails have one restrained flow so the legs and hand remain visible.
High-end detailed hand-painted 2D Korean RPG sprite, excellent cloth folds, accurate natural hands and face, clean silhouette, strong small-scale readability, no pixel art or plastic 3D toy. No giant magic aura; effects will be rendered separately. No sword needed.
OUTPUT: One centered complete character only, PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background, alpha=0 on all empty pixels. No painted checkerboard, no scene, no clouds, no ruins, no caption including the original quote, no text at all, no logo, frame, floor, or shadow. Keep all hair, hand, coat edges and feet inside with 8% transparent safety margin. Aim square 1536x1536, foot tips near y=.90 with horizontal foot pivot centered. Preserve opaque character with smooth transparent antialiasing.
backgroundEditPrompt: EDIT THIS EXACT IMAGE. Replace the entire grey checkerboard background with a single perfectly flat pure CHROMA KEY GREEN (#00FF00) background. Green everywhere outside the person including finger/arm/leg gaps. Do NOT use transparency, checkerboard, gradients, shadows or reflections. Keep the complete existing character pixel-faithful in style and design: same adult face and expression, same detailed clothing and hairstyle, same exact pose and proportions, no added or removed accessories. All white clothing must remain white. Only change the background. Keep hair, hands and shoes inside the image, leave an empty green safety border. This keyed source is for the project's existing technical PNG-alpha export pipeline; color may not spill onto the character.
